originalFailure.mapping: The original three histories were checked against two runtimes. This portable gate checks the same three unchanged histories through object and JSON-text SDK transports, with identical expected direct graphs.

primaryReferences.rule: Item WW and RW target the next version; predicate edges follow a distinct rule.
